class.name: SteamWorkshopPage
class.brief_description: A bounded Workshop result page and continuation cursor.

method.name: get_items
method.description: Read-only, detached item snapshots in Steam's result order. A page contains up to 50 items.

method.description: The opaque cursor for the next page. An empty cursor marks the end.
